tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Search active job listings with optional filters (search text, location, category, employment type, location type)
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.status = 'active' AND (:search IS NULL OR j.title LIKE :search_like OR j.description LIKE :search_like OR c.name LIKE :search_like) AND (:location IS NULL OR j.location LIKE :location_like) AND (:category IS NULL OR j.category = :category) AND (:employment_type IS NULL OR j.employment_type = :employment_type) AND (:location_type IS NULL OR j.location_type = :location_type) ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET :offset

tools.name: count_jobs
tools.description: Count active job listings matching the same filters as list_jobs
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.status = 'active' AND (:search IS NULL OR j.title LIKE :search_like OR j.description LIKE :search_like OR c.name LIKE :search_like) AND (:location IS NULL OR j.location LIKE :location_like) AND (:category IS NULL OR j.category = :category) AND (:employment_type IS NULL OR j.employment_type = :employment_type) AND (:location_type IS NULL OR j.location_type = :location_type) LIMIT 1

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get full details of a specific job by id, with company info
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.status = 'active' LIMIT 1

tools.name: get_job_by_slug
tools.description: Get full details of an active job by slug, with company info
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.slug = :slug AND j.status = 'active' LIMIT 1

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Full-text-ish search of active jobs by title, description or company name
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.status = 'active' AND (j.title LIKE :term OR j.description LIKE :term OR c.name LIKE :term) ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies with optional search by name or industry, ordered by name
tools.sql: SELECT id, name, slug, logo_url, description, website, location, industry, size, created_at FROM companies WHERE (:search IS NULL OR name LIKE :search_like OR industry LIKE :search_like) ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 20 OFFSET :offset

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get a company profile by id
tools.sql: SELECT id, name, slug, logo_url, description, website, location, industry, size, created_at FROM companies WHERE id = :company_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: get_company_by_slug
tools.description: Get a company profile by slug
tools.sql: SELECT id, name, slug, logo_url, description, website, location, industry, size, created_at FROM companies WHERE slug = :slug LIMIT 1

tools.name: company_jobs
tools.description: List active jobs at a specific company by company id
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.company_id = :company_id AND j.status = 'active' ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save a job to the caller's saved list
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO saved_jobs (id, user_id, job_id, saved_at) VALUES (:__uuid, :__user_id, :job_id, :__now)

tools.name: unsave_job
tools.description: Remove a job from the caller's saved list
tools.sql: DELETE FROM saved_jobs WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND job_id = :job_id

tools.name: list_saved_jobs
tools.description: List the caller's saved jobs, newest saved first
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM saved_jobs s JOIN jobs j ON j.id = s.job_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE s.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY s.saved_at DESC

tools.name: is_job_saved
tools.description: Whether the caller has saved a given job (returns a count row)
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM saved_jobs WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND job_id = :job_id

tools.name: apply_to_job
tools.description: Apply to a job as the caller and notify the job poster (atomic). The notification only inserts for jobs with a poster and only when this is a new application.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO applications (id, user_id, job_id, status, note, candidate_name, contact_email, applied_at) SELECT :__uuid, :__user_id, :job_id, 'applied', :note, trim(:candidate_name), trim(:contact_email), :__now WHERE length(trim(:candidate_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND length(:contact_email) <= 254 AND trim(:contact_email) LIKE '%_@_%._%' AND length(trim(:note)) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.status = 'active' AND j.source_url IS NULL AND j.posted_by IS NOT NULL AND j.posted_by != :__user_id AND COALESCE(c.owner_user_id, '') != :__user_id)

INSERT INTO notifications (id, user_id, type, title, body, link, created_at) SELECT :notification_id, j.posted_by, 'new_application', 'New application', 'Someone applied to "' || j.title || '"', '#/applicants/' || :job_id, :__now FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.posted_by IS NOT NULL AND changes() = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM applications a WHERE a.id = :__uuid AND a.user_id = :__user_id AND a.job_id = :job_id)

tools.name: withdraw_application
tools.description: Withdraw the caller's application to a job
tools.sql: DELETE FROM applications WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND job_id = :job_id

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List the caller's job applications with job and company info, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location, a.status AS application_status, a.applied_at, a.note, a.candidate_name, a.contact_email FROM applications a JOIN jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE a.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Get the caller's application status for a specific job
tools.sql: SELECT status, applied_at, note, candidate_name, contact_email FROM applications WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND job_id = :job_id

tools.name: update_application_note
tools.description: Update the note on the caller's own application to a job
tools.sql: UPDATE applications SET note = :note WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND job_id = :job_id

tools.name: record_view
tools.description: Record that the caller viewed a job (upsert of last-viewed time)
tools.sql: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO recent_views (id, user_id, job_id, viewed_at) VALUES (:__uuid, :__user_id, :job_id, :__now)

tools.name: list_recent_views
tools.description: List jobs the caller recently viewed, most recent first
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM recent_views v JOIN jobs j ON j.id = v.job_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE v.user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY v.viewed_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: clear_recent_views
tools.description: Clear the caller's recent-views history
tools.sql: DELETE FROM recent_views WHERE user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: register_company
tools.description: Register a new company owned by the caller
tools.sql: INSERT INTO companies (id, name, slug, logo_url, description, website, location, industry, size, owner_user_id, created_at) SELECT :id, :name, :slug, NULL, :description, :website, :location, :industry, :size, :__user_id, :__now WHERE length(trim(:name)) > 0

tools.name: update_company
tools.description: Update an owned company. Each set_FIELD flag applies that field; omitted flags preserve values. Optional text may be cleared with an empty string.
tools.sql: UPDATE companies SET name = CASE WHEN :set_name = 1 THEN :name ELSE name END, description = CASE WHEN :set_description = 1 THEN :description ELSE description END, website = CASE WHEN :set_website = 1 THEN :website ELSE website END, location = CASE WHEN :set_location = 1 THEN :location ELSE location END, industry = CASE WHEN :set_industry = 1 THEN :industry ELSE industry END, size = CASE WHEN :set_size = 1 THEN :size ELSE size END WHERE id = :company_id AND owner_user_id = :__user_id AND (:set_name IS NULL OR :set_name = 0 OR length(trim(:name)) > 0)

tools.name: get_my_companies
tools.description: List companies the caller owns, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM companies WHERE owner_user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: is_company_owner
tools.description: Whether the caller owns a given company (returns a count row)
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM companies WHERE id = :company_id AND owner_user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: post_job
tools.description: Post a job under a company the caller owns. The ownership check is in the SQL: the row only inserts when the caller owns the target company.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO jobs (id, company_id, title, slug, description, location, location_type, salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, employment_type, category, experience_level, posted_at, source, status, posted_by, created_at) SELECT :id, :company_id, :title, :slug, :description, :location, :location_type, :salary_min, :salary_max, :salary_currency, :employment_type, :category, :experience_level, :__now, 'employer', 'active', :__user_id, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companies c WHERE c.id = :company_id AND c.owner_user_id = :__user_id) AND length(trim(:title)) > 0 AND length(trim(:description)) > 0 AND length(trim(:category)) > 0 AND (:salary_min IS NULL OR :salary_min >= 0) AND (:salary_max IS NULL OR :salary_max >= 0) AND (:salary_min IS NULL OR :salary_max IS NULL OR :salary_min <= :salary_max)

tools.name: share_job
tools.description: Share a real job you found or were recommended. source_url must be the ORIGINAL posting on the company's own careers site or its ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, SmartRecruiters...), https only; job boards and aggregators (SEEK, LinkedIn, Indeed, Jora, Glassdoor...) are rejected, so find the source posting first. source_host is the lowercase hostname of source_url. The job attaches to the company with company_slug, or creates it. Slugs are lowercase a-z, 0-9 and hyphens. Rejected or duplicate (same active source_url) submissions change nothing; candidates apply on the original site. The job then appears under get_my_jobs, and the sharer can close it with close_job.
statements: INSERT INTO jobs (id, company_id, title, slug, description, location, location_type, salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency, employment_type, category, experience_level, posted_at, source, source_url, status, posted_by, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, COALESCE((SELECT id FROM companies WHERE slug = :company_slug), :__uuid), trim(:title), :slug, :description, :location, :location_type, :salary_min, :salary_max, :salary_currency, :employment_type, :category, :experience_level, :__now, 'community', :source_url, 'active', :__user_id, :__now WHERE length(:source_url) <= 2048 AND length(:source_host) BETWEEN 4 AND 253 AND :source_host NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9.-]*' AND :source_host GLOB '*[a-z0-9].[a-z]*' AND (:source_url = 'https://' || :source_host OR substr(:source_url, 1, length(:source_host) + 9) = 'https://' || :source_host || '/') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 'seek' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'linkedin' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'indeed' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'glassdoor' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'jora' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'careerone' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'adzuna' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'ziprecruiter' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'simplyhired' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'careerjet' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'jooble' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 'gotjob' AS label) b WHERE '.' || :source_host || '.' LIKE '%.' || b.label || '.%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 'lnkd.in' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'monster.com' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'monster.com.au' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'talent.com' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'google.com' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'proappstore.online' AS domain) d WHERE :source_host = d.domain OR :source_host LIKE '%.' || d.domain) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE source_url = :source_url AND status = 'active') AND length(trim(:title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:category)) > 0 AND length(trim(:company_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND :slug GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND :slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(:slug) <= 120 AND :company_slug GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND :company_slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(:company_slug) <= 120 AND (:salary_min IS NULL OR :salary_min >= 0) AND (:salary_max IS NULL OR :salary_max >= 0) AND (:salary_min IS NULL OR :salary_max IS NULL OR :salary_min <= :salary_max)

INSERT INTO companies (id, name, slug, logo_url, description, website, location, industry, size, owner_user_id, created_at) SELECT :__uuid, trim(:company_name), :company_slug, NULL, NULL, :company_website, :location, NULL, NULL, NULL, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE id = :__uuid AND company_id = :__uuid AND posted_by = :__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companies WHERE slug = :company_slug)

LIKE '%.' || b.label || '.%') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 'lnkd.in' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'monster.com' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'monster.com.au' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'talent.com' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'google.com' AS domain UNION ALL SELECT 'proappstore.online' AS domain) d WHERE :source_host = d.domain OR :source_host LIKE '%.' || d.domain) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE source_url = :source_url AND status = 'active') AND length(trim(:title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:category)) > 0 AND length(trim(:company_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND :slug GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND :slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(:slug) <= 120 AND :company_slug GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND :company_slug NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*' AND length(:company_slug) <= 120 AND (:salary_min IS NULL OR :salary_min >= 0) AND (:salary_max IS NULL OR :salary_max >= 0) AND (:salary_min IS NULL OR :salary_max IS NULL OR :salary_min <= :salary_max) LIMIT 1

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Update an owned job. Each set_FIELD flag applies that field; omitted flags preserve values and nullable salary fields can be explicitly cleared.
tools.sql: UPDATE jobs SET title = CASE WHEN :set_title = 1 THEN :title ELSE title END, description = CASE WHEN :set_description = 1 THEN :description ELSE description END, location = CASE WHEN :set_location = 1 THEN :location ELSE location END, location_type = CASE WHEN :set_location_type = 1 THEN :location_type ELSE location_type END, salary_min = CASE WHEN :set_salary_min = 1 THEN :salary_min ELSE salary_min END, salary_max = CASE WHEN :set_salary_max = 1 THEN :salary_max ELSE salary_max END, salary_currency = CASE WHEN :set_salary_currency = 1 THEN :salary_currency ELSE salary_currency END, employment_type = CASE WHEN :set_employment_type = 1 THEN :employment_type ELSE employment_type END, category = CASE WHEN :set_category = 1 THEN :category ELSE category END, experience_level = CASE WHEN :set_experience_level = 1 THEN :experience_level ELSE experience_level END, status = CASE WHEN :set_status = 1 THEN :status ELSE status END WHERE id = :job_id AND posted_by = :__user_id AND (:set_title IS NULL OR :set_title = 0 OR length(trim(:title)) > 0) AND (:set_description IS NULL OR :set_description = 0 OR length(trim(:description)) > 0) AND (:set_category IS NULL OR :set_category = 0 OR length(trim(:category)) > 0) AND (:set_status IS NULL OR :set_status = 0 OR :status IN ('active','closed')) AND ((CASE WHEN :set_salary_min = 1 THEN :salary_min ELSE salary_min END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN :set_salary_min = 1 THEN :salary_min ELSE salary_min END) >= 0) AND ((CASE WHEN :set_salary_max = 1 THEN :salary_max ELSE salary_max END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN :set_salary_max = 1 THEN :salary_max ELSE salary_max END) >= 0) AND ((CASE WHEN :set_salary_min = 1 THEN :salary_min ELSE salary_min END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN :set_salary_max = 1 THEN :salary_max ELSE salary_max END) IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN :set_salary_min = 1 THEN :salary_min ELSE salary_min END) <= (CASE WHEN :set_salary_max = 1 THEN :salary_max ELSE salary_max END))

tools.name: close_job
tools.description: Close a job the caller posted (guarded by posted_by = caller)
tools.sql: UPDATE jobs SET status = 'closed' WHERE id = :job_id AND posted_by = :__user_id AND status = 'active'

tools.name: get_my_jobs
tools.description: List jobs the caller posted, with company name and applicant counts
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.status, j.posted_at, c.name AS company_name, COUNT(a.id) AS applicant_count FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id LEFT JOIN applications a ON a.job_id = j.id WHERE j.posted_by = :__user_id GROUP BY j.id ORDER BY j.posted_at DESC

tools.name: get_job_applicants
tools.description: List applicants for a job the caller posted. The ownership guard is in the WHERE clause: rows only return when the caller posted the job.
tools.sql: SELECT a.user_id, a.status, a.note, a.candidate_name, a.contact_email, a.applied_at FROM applications a WHERE a.job_id = :job_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.posted_by = :__user_id) ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC

tools.name: update_applicant_status
tools.description: Set an applicant's status on a job the caller posted. Guarded: only the job poster can update, derived from the job row.
tools.sql: UPDATE applications SET status = :status WHERE job_id = :job_id AND user_id = :applicant_user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs j WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.posted_by = :__user_id) AND :status IN ('applied', 'interview', 'offer', 'rejected')

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.description: List the caller's notifications, newest first (max 50)
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: mark_notification_read
tools.description: Mark one of the caller's notifications read
tools.sql: UPDATE notifications SET read = 1 WHERE id = :notification_id AND user_id = :__user_id

tools.name: mark_all_notifications_read
tools.description: Mark all of the caller's unread notifications read
tools.sql: UPDATE notifications SET read = 1 WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND read = 0

tools.name: count_unread_notifications
tools.description: Count the caller's unread notifications (returns a count row)
tools.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM notifications WHERE user_id = :__user_id AND read = 0

tools.name: op_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs for owner/moderator review with search, status and keyset paging.
tools.sql: SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.title, c.name AS company_name, j.location, j.status, j.posted_at FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE (:q IS NULL OR j.title LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR c.name LIKE '%' || :q || '%') AND (:status IS NULL OR j.status = :status) AND (:after IS NULL OR j.id > :after) ORDER BY j.id ASC LIMIT 50

caller_unscoped.reason: App owners and appointed moderators inspect marketplace listings across employers.

tools.name: op_job_detail
tools.description: Inspect one listing without employer identity or applicant data.
tools.sql: SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.title, c.name AS company_name, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.employment_type, j.category, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.posted_at FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.id = :job_id LIMIT 1

caller_unscoped.reason: App owners and appointed moderators inspect marketplace listings across employers.

tools.name: op_close_job
tools.description: Close an active listing as owner/moderator; stale or repeated requests change nothing.
tools.sql: UPDATE jobs SET status = 'closed' WHERE id = :job_id AND status = :from_status AND status = 'active'

caller_unscoped.reason: App owners and appointed moderators may close one active listing by ID and expected status.

tools.name: op_list_companies
tools.description: List companies for owner/moderator review with search and keyset paging.
tools.sql: SELECT id AS company_id, name, location, industry, created_at FROM companies WHERE (:q IS NULL OR name LIKE '%' || :q || '%' OR industry LIKE '%' || :q || '%') AND (:after IS NULL OR id > :after) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50

caller_unscoped.reason: App owners and appointed moderators inspect marketplace listings across employers.

tools.name: op_company_detail
tools.description: Inspect a company profile without exposing its owner identity.
tools.sql: SELECT id AS company_id, name, description, website, location, industry, size, created_at FROM companies WHERE id = :company_id LIMIT 1

caller_unscoped.reason: App owners and appointed moderators inspect marketplace listings across employers.

tools.name: get_my_job
tools.description: Read one job for its actual poster, including closed listings.
tools.sql: SELECT j.id, j.company_id, j.title, j.slug, j.description, j.location, j.location_type, j.salary_min, j.salary_max, j.salary_currency, j.employment_type, j.category, j.experience_level, j.posted_at, j.expires_at, j.source, j.source_url, j.status, j.created_at, c.name AS company_name, c.slug AS company_slug, c.logo_url AS company_logo_url, c.location AS company_location FROM jobs j JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE j.id = :job_id AND j.posted_by = :__user_id LIMIT 1

actions.title: Close listing
actions.confirm: Close this listing and remove it from active job search?
